environment.description: Same Go microservice on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/task-svc-acl/abc123) with a custom rule group 'binary-payload-inspection' at priority 1. This rule group contains a ByteMatchStatement that inspects the request Body (first 8192 bytes) for gob-encoded type registration signatures containing the strings '/bin/', '/usr/', 'exec', 'sh', 'bash', 'cmd' using SearchString with a PositionalConstraint of CONTAINS, applied only when Content-Type header exactly matches 'application/octet-stream'. The rule action is BLOCK with a 403 CustomResponse. Additionally, a second rule at priority 2 uses a SizeConstraint on Body with a ComparisonOperator GT and Size 4096 to block oversized binary payloads. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating and blocking matching requests (non-zero BlockedRequests metric over trailing 24h).
